prompt:
A large amount of the food that households buy is thrown away without being eaten.

What problems does this cause and what measures could be taken?
instruction_line: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
key_points: The questions must be answered separately: a problems section plus a measures section.
At least two problems: household budget being wasted, and the waste of water/energy/land spent on production, plus the burden of waste.
The problems need to be explained through a cause-and-effect chain; simply listing them is not enough.
The measures should come from different levels: planned shopping and storage at home, portion sizes and labelling in shops, and awareness-raising at school.
The measures are expected to be practical; 'people should be careful' on its own is weak.
common_mistakes: Drifting into the topic of hunger and losing sight of the actual question (problems and measures).
Placing all the measures on a single party (only the government).
Telling the topic through a personal anecdote.
